intent: Return scoped recent commit metadata only under an exact current source binding; rebuild stale cache data and never treat history as a session or authority.

required_conditions: explicit unambiguous project or literal path scope
first-parent history bounded to at most 100 commits and 1000 displayed file changes
HEAD, branch, worktree, shallow boundary, schema, scope and limits match the snapshot
query cannot write tracked files, Git index, refs, hooks or cache
explicit refresh writes only derived Git-private per-worktree cache
uncommitted work is separately observed; submodules are gitlinks only
no durable session lifecycle or operational authority inferred
